summary: Tested 4 new features on top of the existing landing page: admin login gate, contact-form email (send-off), bilingual legal pages, and Before/After gallery. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed covering /auth/login (success + wrong pw + wrong email), /auth/me (with/without/bad token), /contact CRUD with 401 gating on list/patch/delete and public POST returning email_sent=false (expected). Frontend Playwright: admin login screen, wrong-password error, successful login, dashboard render, token persisted in localStorage la_admin_token across reload, logout clears token and returns to login. Contact form submitted from homepage, lead appears in admin dashboard. Legal pages /impressum /datenschutz /agb all render with title + sections, DE/EN language toggle switches content (Impressum -> Imprint). Footer legal link navigates correctly. Before/After gallery: tabs 0/1/2 switch active pair (title change verified), slider handle drag works. No console errors on flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH is generated once at module import from env var. This works, but rotating password requires backend restart (documented behaviour, acceptable for single-admin gate).
server.py: bcrypt hash lives only in process memory (not persisted). If desired for production, persist a bcrypt hash to DB or env directly ($2b$...) instead of hashing plaintext at boot.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login. Acceptable for demo, but recommend adding a simple in-memory throttle (e.g. 5 attempts / 15 min per IP) before production.
seed_data_creation: Test lead 'TEST_UI_User_XYZ' created via UI and admin-verified, then cleaned up via API DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 19 tests). Auth JWT stored client-side in localStorage la_admin_token. email_sent=false from /api/contact is EXPECTED (RESEND_API_KEY empty) — do NOT flag as bug. Legal pages use React Router (/impressum, /datenschutz, /agb). Gallery uses data-testids gallery-section, gallery-tab-{0,1,2}, gallery-item-title, before-after-slider, before-after-handle.
